name: Backpack
tagline: Turns school and activity emails into calendar entries, reminders and a weekly plan
description: Parents get a pile of school newsletters, activity notices and permission slips they never have time to read. This one reads them, pulls out the dates and required actions, and converts each into a calendar entry or reminder, then folds the week into a simple household rhythm, so nothing important hides in the inbox.
author: RohanBhanotAI
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
